question: What is the role of the encoder in the Transformer?
ground_truth: The encoder transforms the input sequence into contextual representations using stacked self-attention and feed-forward layers.
answer: According to the provided context, specifically in section 3, "the encoder maps an input sequence of symbol representations (x1,...,x n) to a sequence of continuous representations z = (z1,...,z n)." This information comes from the document, section 3, Model Architecture.
